title: Daily Devotional #66
paragraphs: As I reflect on Luke 22, I am struck by the depth of love that Jesus had for His disciples and for us, His followers. In this chapter, we see Jesus prepare Himself for the ultimate sacrifice - His death on the cross - and yet, in the midst of His own suffering, He is still thinking of His disciples.

Jesus knew that His time on earth was coming to an end, and He wanted to spend one final meal with His closest friends. He knew that one of His own would betray Him, yet He still offered love and forgiveness to Judas. He knew that Peter would deny Him, yet He still prayed for him and offered words of encouragement.

Jesus also gave His disciples a new commandment - to love one another as He had loved them. This commandment is not easy to follow, but it is essential for those who follow Jesus. We must love others sacrificially, just as He loved us sacrificially.

As I think about my own life, I realize that I often fall short in this area. I find it difficult to love others who have hurt me or who are different from me. But Jesus showed us that true love is not dependent on how others treat us or what they look like. True love is unconditional and selfless.

Lord, please help me to love others as You have loved me. Help me to forgive those who have hurt me and to show kindness to those who are different from me. And thank You for Your ultimate sacrifice on the cross, which makes it possible for me to have eternal life with You.
